answer: Charge each identity in attention: every epoch, an agent completes a short verification round — a fresh cognitive task keyed to that identity alone. A sybil operator can script ten thousand wallets, yet each fake must cross the same meadow alone, since tasks are new each round and scored on behavioral signatures. His botnet is a dune of identical grains, and a dune casts one long shadow — clustering flags mass submissions. The basalt beneath is time pressure on one key, so parallelizing thousands costs proportional effort. Limit: AI solvers improve yearly and honest agents pay friction too.
